# nemau_snapshot (Resource)

A crash-consistent copy of an instance's system disk, stored on the object store and billed on the bytes actually stored. Attached volumes are never included. Immutable: any change recreates it.

Creation waits until the disk has reached the object store, which can take hours for a large disk; the provider sets no timeout of its own. Deleting the instance deletes its snapshots.

Terraform does not restore snapshots. Use `nemau compute snapshot restore <id>` or one of the SDKs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_snapshot" "web" {
  instance_id = nemau_instance.web.id
  name        = "web-before-upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Id of the instance whose system disk is captured.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Snapshot id, the value `nemau compute snapshot restore` takes.
- `monthly_cost` (Number) Price excluding VAT of keeping `size_bytes` stored for a 730-hour month, in euros.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Bytes the object store holds for this snapshot (the compressed archive). This is the billed size.
- `source_disk_gb` (Number) Capacity of the system disk that was captured, in GB.
- `status` (String) `creating`, `active` or `restoring`.
- `storage` (String) `object_store`, or `hypervisor` for an older snapshot kept on the hypervisor. Those can be listed and deleted, but are not billed and cannot be restored.

## Import

```shell
# A snapshot imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_snapshot.web 0c7e5a91-3b2d-4c6f-8e14-9a5b7d2f6c38
```
